member.summary: Registers this options instance for validation of its DataAnnotations.
member.remarks: Synchronous validation runs when the options instance is created or accessed. When targeting .NET 11 or later, asynchronous validation (including AsyncValidationAttribute-derived attributes) runs once at startup, and only when ValidateOnStart() is also called. If ValidateOnStart() is not called, attributes deriving from AsyncValidationAttribute are never evaluated asynchronously: runtime options access triggers only synchronous validation, which invokes the attribute's synchronous fallback instead. When using AsyncValidationAttribute-derived attributes, ensure the synchronous IsValid fallback does not throw: synchronous validation still runs on every options access, so a throwing fallback surfaces as an exception on each access (for example when resolving IOptions{TOptions}.Value), even if startup validation succeeded.
